author_requested_focus: Handling large differential delay and Doppler shift.
Huang-style effective-channel prior description with colored-Gaussian-noise training.
english_abstract: This paper investigates joint activity detection and channel estimation (JADCE) for grant-free random access in low Earth orbit satellite Internet-of-Things systems without global navigation satellite system (GNSS) assistance. We firstly propose a multi-frame transmission scheme with affine frequency division multiplexing (AFDM) to handle the large differential delay and Doppler shift, and derive the input-output relationship. Subsequently, we learn a score-based generative channel prior directly on the AFDM effective channel with fractional delay and Doppler, without restrictive sparse or grid-aligned channel assumptions. The training uses colored Gaussian noise to account for correlations in the denoiser input error. With the learned channel prior available, we employ a turbo message passing (TMP) framework to perform linear estimation and denoising iteratively, incorporating the prior through a minimum mean-squared error (MMSE) denoiser. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed receiver outperforms the original score-based TMP receiver in terms of activity detection and channel estimation.
